messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Thresholds crossed (5xx > 5%). Pager: Marta. Auto-alert created.
Marta: On it — seeing spike in 5xx from model-worker pool in us-east. Tailing logs now.
Tom: Support seeing ~10 customer tickets mentioning failed generation and timeouts. Adding to incident triage.
Marta: Root cause unclear yet. Collecting worker logs and metrics. Can someone draft the initial status page blurb? Need impact (regions, % of requests) + mitigation notes.
Denise: I can draft the initial notice. Quick Q: any hard numbers for impact window or affected percent? Also who will publish (status page + CS pings)?
Raj: Looking at autoscaler and kube events — several model-worker pods were OOMKilled around the time of the spike. Suspect a large-batch workload caused worker thrash. Mitigation plan: scale up worker pool and restart affected nodes.
Marta: Scaling and draining affected nodes now. Expect capacity to stabilize in ~8-12m.
Denise: Drafting initial update. Proposed copy:
```
We are investigating increased error rates and elevated latency for text generation in US-East (us-east-1). Some customers may experience failed requests or timeouts. Our engineers are actively investigating and scaling capacity to restore normal service. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or as we have significant changes.
```
Denise: Link to draft: https://docs.internal.redwood/status-drafts/IN-2026-045 (please review)
Marta: Add numbers: peak 5xx ~7.2% between 09:14–09:32 UTC, current ~4.8%. Approximately 12% of requests impacted in that window. Region: us-east-1 only. No indication of data loss.
Raj: Recommend adding mitigation detail: 'we are scaling workers and routing traffic away from degraded capacity; retries are being applied where applicable.'
Denise: Updated draft with mitigation language. Ready to publish once you give thumbs.
Marta: Looks good to me. Publish initial update to statuspage and push a note to #customer-success with the canned message.
Denise: Publishing initial status page update now and posting CS note. Command used:
```
status-cli post --incident IN-2026-045 --state investigating --body "We are investigating increased error rates for text generation in US-East. Engineers are scaling capacity and monitoring."
```
Denise: Posted initial update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IN-2026-045 :published_with_lightning:
Tom: Copy. I'll send targeted messages to impacted customers with the predetermined template.
Marta: Handoff: Raj will take the next 60m for monitoring. I'll stay on-call for escalations.
Raj: Taking handoff. First monitoring tick: error rate down to 2.1%, tail latency improving. I'll post 15–30m updates here.
Denise: Preparing periodic update template: 'Service performance is improving; engineers are continuing to scale capacity and monitor. Next update in 30 minutes.'
Raj: Works for me. Will report any regressions immediately.
Raj: (30m) Update: errors stable ~1.5%, internal retries visible but user-facing failures reduced. Continuing to monitor.
Denise: Publishing periodic update to status page and notifying CS that impact is reduced.
Denise: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IN-2026-045/updates :pencil2:
Olly: Noted — ops alerting thresholds will be reviewed after the incident.
Raj: (1.5h) Update: error rate back to baseline (~0.1%), latencies normal. No further customer-facing failures observed.
Denise: Publishing resolved notice now. Resolved copy:
```
Resolved — The elevated error rates affecting text generation in US-East have been mitigated. Traffic routing and scale adjustments have restored service to normal levels. No customer data loss was detected. If you continue to see issues, contact support.
```
Denise: Resolved notice published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IN-2026-045/resolved :white_check_mark:
Tom: Closing customer notifications — will send final follow-up to those who reported issues.
Marta: Thanks team. Action items: Raj to open a postmortem (include autoscaler behavior + batch spike reproduction steps), Denise to send a customer-facing summary and coordinate any follow-ups with legal/compliance if needed.
Raj: Will open postmortem ticket and link logs/graphs.
Denise: I'll draft the CS summary and share for review.
Marta: Good job. I'll file incident handoff notes and mark as monitored. :thumbsup:
